svg.title: Narration ambience — Lower detail
svg.desc: Decorative audio ambience; not an actual audio waveform. Loop duration 5.6 seconds. Animate in a modern browser. To use in PowerPoint/video, render frames or record a timed browser playback; SVG import may be static. Transparent source canvas; export alpha as WebM/ProRes 4444 when needed. Preserve animation duration and 1920x1080 aspect ratio. Original artwork, CC BY 4.0. Attribution: AI Update Sources.
